scope: Review of scientific prespecification clarity, internal selection/firewall rules, documented implementation semantics, existing construction diagnostics and duplicate/count disclosures; not a replacement for the separate exhaustive source/interval validator.
interpretation: PASS means the proposed methods, exceptions, and stop conditions are explicit and internally coherent. It does not mean the constructed datasets pass matching-readiness gates or that training may start.
review_addendum: After initial review, section 8 was clarified to describe assay-wide ATAC percentile construction exactly. Only the document/review changed; frozen features, matches and datasets were not modified. The revised document hash above is authoritative for this final review.

methodology_checks.evidence: Section 8 now states that within-source ATAC percentiles use all canonical chromosomes, including chr7-9, and therefore are not train-fitted preprocessing. These are matching annotations, not neural-network inputs. Held-out covariate distributions contribute to construction; held-out predictive scores and performance remain unopened. A source-specific training-chromosome-only empirical CDF is a prospective approved-version improvement, not a retroactive claim or silent feature change.
methodology_checks.readiness_effect: This disclosed covariate-distribution use limits a strictly inductive description but is not evidence of test-performance tuning or a new automatic hard gate under the requested all-split construction/QC scope. The existing 18 matching failures continue to make the dataset NOT_READY.

methodology_checks.evidence: Sections 2, 4 and 17 preserve A membership, B positives and identical B/C controls in the constructed version; V1-to-A is explicitly an orientation/validation package. Conditional rematching or common-support restriction requires an approved new version and an explicitly changed estimand.

Sections 7-10 and selection JSON separate native checkpoint-role symmetric BCE from the shared selection panel and unopened calibration controls. Global overlap/encoded-identity groups cannot cross roles.

Common same-lobe-positive/accessibility-control panels are fixed across A/B/C; native AUPRC is descriptive and cannot rank models across differing prevalence/labels. Common panel sample counts are adequate in number only, without waiving matching failures.

Section 10 and selection JSON define AP primary, separate AUROC/Brier guardrails, explicit superiority/equivalence/noninferiority conditions, pragmatic 0.02 margins and distinct noninferior-only results. Retaining full C requires both model contexts to be adequate and C noninferior to B; no test-based tie breaker or automatic mixed configuration.

Bootstrap resamples represented genomic/encoded-sequence components with replacement, carries all rows and identical multiplicities across configurations, conditions on fixed matching rather than merging remote matching links, uses 2000 valid draws and explicit invalid-draw limits. Adequacy bootstraps AP minus replicate prevalence and Brier skill directly.

Seeds 104729, 130363 and 155921 are fixed across all configurations/models. All three contribute equal prediction weight. Native checkpoint selection, earliest-epoch ties, explicit RNG substreams and hard seed-stability review stops preclude seed or checkpoint cherry-picking.

Final probabilities are averaged over independently embedded forward/RC nucleotide sequences and then over all three seeds. REF/ALT identities remain separate. The CPU-only synthetic contract has 53 passing checks and zero failures; real trained-network invariance remains explicitly NOT_RUN and mandatory later.

Only common chr7 calibration negatives after retained-model freeze determine the nextafter-based conservative 5% empirical FPR threshold. One-based Markdown and zero-based JSON/script formulas agree, n>=200 is required, and serialized float precision is retained. No population or two-allele-maximum 5% FPR claim is made.

Region performance is not claimed to validate allele deltas. The historical candidate-universe 95th percentile is descriptive only; no new delta cutoff or causal list is introduced. External labels/outcomes cannot select design, thresholds or configurations, and future external opening follows model/inference/threshold freeze.

Opening disposition and sections 16-17 explicitly prohibit training the current freeze because matching fails. Investigator choices concern changed population/contrast design, not post-outcome seed/model tuning or gate relaxation.

Selected duplicate table contains 18 rows in 9 canonical encoded/RC groups, all train role. Intersecting their IDs with all six configuration manifests gives 18 in enhancer B, 18 in enhancer C and zero in A or H3K27me3, matching the final document.

The available-denominator table confirms A enhancer control intensities observed for only 60/307473 train, 3/20328 validation and 7/34903 test; A H3K27me3 has 12/51839, 2/3427 and 3/5902. These cannot represent all-control accessibility. Final prose distinguishes them from complete interval-overlap fractions; B/C intensities are fully observed.

documented_implementation_exceptions.initial_claim: The abbreviated matching specification states coordinate-ID tie ordering without limiting its candidate scope.
documented_implementation_exceptions.executed_semantics: The constructor resolves equal distances within a returned cKDTree nearest-neighbor batch; a tie extending beyond the batch need not select the globally lowest coordinate ID.
documented_implementation_exceptions.synthetic_confirmation: For 1000 equal-distance candidates generated with RNG seed 0, k=64 omitted global index 0 and returned minimum index 14.
documented_implementation_exceptions.observed_independent_audit: The retained preliminary strict-tie validation reports 1 discrepancy among 199788 matching pairs under the stronger global lexicographic check. This finding is not erased by documenting the weaker executed semantics.
documented_implementation_exceptions.resolution: Final Markdown and append-only matching implementation notes disclose bounded-query semantics. Selected intervals/calipers are preserved, not silently rematched. The exhaustive validator separately evaluates distance/caliper validity and records the observed tie exception.
Selection JSON and append-only implementation notes explicitly specify the first 16 hex digits; the original abbreviated matching specification remains preserved.

independently_reconciled_readiness.conclusion: NOT_READY: accessible donor provenance is established, but the selected covariate distributions violate the frozen gates. Passing fidelity checks cannot waive these failures.

remaining_actions_requiring_approval: Choose a separately versioned B matching/common-support/ratio correction, explicitly acknowledging any change to the full V1-positive contrast.
Choose whether to authorize C-specific rematching, explicitly treating its comparison as label change plus induced control-rematching rather than a pure label-only effect.
Require replacement audited data/rule freeze before considering separate GPU authorization; current freeze cannot be trained as a clean matched experiment.
not_certified_by_this_review: The current dataset is not training-ready.
No actual trained-network invariance, region predictive performance or allele-effect validity has been established.
The review does not approve the pragmatic margins as uniquely optimal or clinically meaningful.
The separate exhaustive final source/interval validation and final artifact checksum ledger remain authoritative for their own scopes.
